test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is TRUE?

options.text: Plastic bags should be used to keep food.
We should not place waste in plastic bags and discard them.
After use, we should dispose of plastic bags by burning them.
Shopkeepers are required to use plastic bags by law.

solution:
The correct answer is __**We should not place waste in plastic bags and discard them**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The major impact of plastic bags on the environment is that it takes **many years for them to decompose**.
 
• In addition, toxic substances are released into the soil when plastic bags perish under sunlight and, if plastic bags are burned, they **release a toxic substance into the air causing ambient air pollution.**
 
• Waste from plastic bags poses a **serious environmental danger **to human and animal health. Thus, we should not place waste in plastic bags and discard them. 
 
• If plastic bags are not properly disposed of, they can impact the environment by **causing littering and stormwater drain blockages**.
 
• Animals may also get **tangled and drown in plastic bags**. 
 
• Animals often confuse the bags for food and consume them, therefore **blocking their digestive processes**.

***Hence statement 2 is correct. ***

 
• Plastic bags when used to keep food release toxic chemicals into them, which directly harm us and our digestive system.
 
• **Burning** of plastic bags releases a lot of greenhouse gases which **harms the environment **as well as our health.
 
• By law, shopkeepers are **restricted** from using plastic bags, instead, they are bags by law.

***Hence the statement 1, 3, and 4 are incorrect.***
